picks.question: Billionaire one-time wealth tax passes in California election 2026?
picks.why: A state-level wealth tax vote would test how much revenue such taxes raise, and whether the very wealthy move away in response.

picks.question: Strait of Hormuz traffic returns to normal by December 31?
picks.why: Shipping through Hormuz carries a large share of global oil, so its disruption feeds directly into energy prices and inflation.

picks.question: Will Anthropic have the best AI model at the end of December 2026?
picks.why: Leadership at the AI frontier shapes where investment, talent and productivity gains concentrate across the technology sector.

picks.question: Will an AI lab announce another Millennium Prize solution by December 31, 2027?
picks.why: AI solving a famous unsolved math problem would signal research capability far beyond automating routine tasks.

picks.question: Will OpenAI’s market cap be $1.5T or greater at market close on IPO day by December 31, 2027?
picks.why: An OpenAI listing near $1.5 trillion would test whether public markets will validate private AI valuations.

picks.question: Will J.D. Vance win the 2028 Republican presidential nomination?
picks.why: An evenly split Republican nomination race leaves open the direction of trade, fiscal and central bank policy after 2028.
